q.en: "While I ___ dinner, the power went out."
q.bn: "While I ___ dinner, the power went out."

why.en: An ongoing action (past continuous) interrupted by a past simple event ("went out").
why.bn: একটা চলমান action (past continuous) যা past simple event ("went out") দিয়ে interrupt হয়েছে।

q.en: "By the time the ambulance arrived, the man ___."
q.bn: "By the time the ambulance arrived, the man ___."

why.en: This event finished before another past event ("arrived"), so it needs past perfect.
why.bn: এই event অন্য একটা past event-এর ("arrived") আগে শেষ হয়েছে, তাই past perfect লাগবে।

q.en: Fix the mistake: "I was knowing the answer, but I didn't say it."
q.bn: ভুলটা ঠিক করো: "I was knowing the answer, but I didn't say it."

options.en: I knew the answer, but I didn't say it.
options.bn: I knew the answer, but I didn't say it.

options.en: I have known the answer, but I didn't say it.
options.bn: I have known the answer, but I didn't say it.

options.en: I know the answer, but I didn't say it.
options.bn: I know the answer, but I didn't say it.

why.en: "Know" is a stative verb — it doesn't take the continuous form, in past tense either.
why.bn: "Know" একটা stative verb — past tense-এও এটা continuous form নেয় না।

q.en: "She ___ English for two years before she moved to Canada."
q.bn: "She ___ English for two years before she moved to Canada."

why.en: Past perfect continuous: the duration was happening up until the later past event ("moved").
why.bn: Past perfect continuous: duration-টা পরের past event ("moved") পর্যন্ত চলছিল।

q.en: Which tense answers "which of two past events happened first"?
q.bn: কোন tense "দুইটা past event-এর মধ্যে কোনটা আগে হয়েছে" তা বোঝায়?

options.en: Past perfect, for the earlier event

why.en: Past perfect marks the earlier of two past events — the later one stays in past simple.
why.bn: Past perfect দুইটা past event-এর মধ্যে আগেরটা চিহ্নিত করে — পরেরটা past simple-এই থাকে।
